description: Call one documented GET (read-only) operation of the DCAST Partner API v1 (https://api.dcast.pro/api/v1). Changes nothing. A GET that the API marks as writing (x-dcast-side-effect, shown by dcast_describe_operation) is refused here and goes to dcast_call_operation. The arguments are checked against the operation's contract first; a mismatch is answered with the exact problems and howToFix and NOTHING is sent. Runs with the connected user's own access: permission, plan limits and rate limits are the API's. Other methods are refused here: POST/PUT/PATCH go to dcast_call_operation, DELETE to dcast_delete_operation.

args.description: { path?: {param: value}, query?: {name: value}, body?: {...} } as in dcast_describe_operation callWith

name: dcast_read_operation
title: Read from the DCAST API
